the period of my membership I have attended only one
meeting at the Association, this being held at Tai Lai
Li, off Barkham Road. The discussions at this meeting
centered around the raising of funds and increasing the
membership of the Association. I understood that the
aims of the Association were to promote patriotism.
I know nothing about Communism and am not interested
in the subject.

(Signed) Woo Fun Ming

Lou Chee ( )
D.S. Sansom
Yulin Rd. St. 6-5-33 Clerk Liao Tsong Chien

My name is Lou Chee, age 24, residing
at 4 Tung Shing Li, Thorburn Road, native of
Chekiang. I was educated by a private teacher
at my home in Chekiang and completed my studies at the
age of 14. For the next 3 years I remained at Chekiang
assisting my father on his farm. At the age of 17
I came to Shanghai and found employment as an apprentice
in the Sing Yah Silk Weaving Factory in the Yih Hwa
Fong, Rue du Marche. I remained in employment there
for about 2 years, during which time I resided in the
vicinity of the Factory. For the next 4 years I worked
in several silk weaving factories in the Settlement,
French Concession and Nantao. Then, at the outbreak
of hostilities locally, I returned to my native home.
I returned to Shanghai in August 1932, and found employ-
ment at the Sing Sung Silk Weaving Factory in the San
Yih Li, off Washing Road. I remained there until
January 1933 when I found employment at the Yah Mei
Silk Weaving Factory on Washing Road, being in
employment there up to the day of my arrest.

I joined the Association to Resist Insult
about 3 weeks ago, and on May 1st I was arrested on
Thorburn Road when, in the company of many others,
I was proceeding to the West Gate to participate
in a mass meeting of the Association.

I had attended only one meeting of the
Association, this being one which was held in the
pages.zh:
楼志（Lou Chee）（ ）
D.S. Sansom
榆林路站 1933年5月6日 书记员廖宗健

本人姓名为楼志，现年24岁，居住于索伯恩路（Thorburn Road）同成里（Tung Shing Li）4号，籍贯浙江。本人在浙江家中由私塾教师教育，14岁时完成学业。随后的3年里，本人留在浙江协助父亲务农。17岁时，本人来到上海，在市场路（Rue du Marche）益华坊（Yih Hwa Fong）的新亚（Sing Yah）丝织厂当学徒。本人在那里工作了约两年，期间居住在工厂附近。随后的4年里，本人在公共租界、法租界和南市的几家丝织厂工作。后来，当地战事爆发，本人返回家乡。
本人于1932年8月返回上海，在 washing Road（注：原文如此，疑为华盛路或类似音译）附近的三益里（San Yih Li）新盛（Sing Sung）丝织厂找到工作。本人一直工作到1933年1月，随后在 washing Road 的亚美（Yah Mei）丝织厂找到工作，并一直工作至被捕之日。

本人约三周前加入“抗侮协会”，5月1日，本人与许多人一同前往西门参加协会的大型集会，途中在索伯恩路被捕。

本人仅参加过协会的一次会议，该会议在

pages.en:
- 2 -
Eastern Branch Office on Sungpan Road. This meeting
was attended by about 100 persons including Wu
Kai. Wu Kai delivered a speech deprecating
the Japanese encroachments in North China and a committee
was elected to represent the Eastern Branch. Nothing
appertained to Communist affairs was discussed. I
am not connected in any way with the Communist Party
and am not interested in their affairs.

(Signed ) Lou Chee.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
嵩山路东部办事处举行。约有100人参加了此次会议，其中包括吴凯。吴凯发表演讲，谴责日本在华北的侵略行为，并选举了一个委员会代表东部办事处。会上未讨论任何与共产党事务相关的内容。本人与共产党没有任何联系，对其事务也不感兴趣。

（签署）楼志。

pages.en:
Yuli Rd
I.

Wong Fu Shiang (王波香). ✓

Kompo.                                D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.      3.5.33.            Clerk Van Ti Foo.

My name is Wong Fu Shiang, aged 28, native of Kompo,
s/ricsha coolie, residing at an unnumbered hut off Hsiang
I Jao, Chapai. I was born in Yien Zung Hsine, Kompo and came
to Shanghai 2 years ago. About 10 days ago I was eating food
in a foodshop on Miller Road when I was asked by a male
Chinese to join the People's Self Salvation Association to
Resist Insult. On the morning of same day I went to 28
Soong Mur Li, Sungpan Road and joined the association. One of
the two persons in the office gave me some handbills to
distribute. On the morning of May 1 I went to 28 Sungpan Rd
at 7 a.m. and was told to go together with about 10 other
persons to the Public Recreation Ground, West Gate, by bus.
The party proceeded to Wayside and Thornburn Road corner where
we were to wait for another party. One of the party Loh Ching
Foo was in possession of the pamphlets but I do not know what
they were about as I do not read. We waited at the corner
of Wayside and Thornburn Rd corner for a few minutes by which
time the crowd had grown to about 200. As we were moving off
to go to the bus a party of Police arrived and after a fight
in which I was not concerned 9 of us were taken into custody.
I am not a communist neither have I knowledge of the pamphlets
seized at the time of my arrest.

Signed: Wong Fu-shiang.
pages.zh:
榆林路
I.

王波香（Wong Fu Shiang）。✓

甘博（Kompo）。 D.S.I. Golder.
榆林路站 1933年5月3日 书记员 Van Ti Foo.

本人姓名为王波香，现年28岁，籍贯甘博，职业为人力车夫，居住于闸北香溢桥（Hsiang I Jao）附近的一间无门牌号的棚屋内。本人出生于甘博的严忠兴（Yien Zung Hsine，音译），两年前来到上海。约十天前，本人在米勒路（Miller Road）的一家小吃店吃饭时，一名中国男子邀请本人加入“人民自救抗侮协会”。当天上午，本人前往嵩山路宋慕里（Soong Mur Li）28号加入了该协会。办事处内的两人之一给本人一些传单分发。5月1日上午7时，本人前往嵩山路28号，被告知与其他约10人一起乘公交车前往西门公共游乐场。队伍行进至威赛司路（Wayside）与索伯恩路转角处，我们要在那里等待另一支队伍。队伍中的一名成员罗清福（Loh Ching Foo）持有小册子，但因本人不识字，不知其内容。我们在威赛司路与索伯恩路转角处等待了几分钟，此时人群已增至约200人。当我们正要动身去乘公交车时，一队警察赶到，经过一场本人并未参与的打斗后，我们9人被拘留。本人不是共产党员，也不知道被捕时查获的小册子的内容。

签署：王波香。

pages.en:
Tsang Tsing Hwa. 張俊華 ✓
Ssechuen                                D.S.I. Holder.
Yulin Rd Str.      3.5.33.              Clerk Vane

My name is Tsang Tsing Hwa, aged 22, native of
Ssechuen, residing at 28 Sung Hou Li, Sungpan Road where I
have been living since the middle of april. I first came to
Shanghai in 1932 and have since that time until recently
resided at Woosung.

On May 1st I was proceeding together with other
members of the people's Self Salvation Association to Resist
Insult to the Public Recreation Ground, Nantao when I was
arrested at Wayside and Thorburn Road corner. I am not a
member of the Chinese Communist Party nor do I know who
had possession of the communistic literature.

Signed: Tsang Tsing Hwa.
pages.zh:
张俊华（Tsang Tsing Hwa）。张俊华 ✓
四川 D.S.I. Holder.
榆林路站 1933年5月3日 书记员 Vane

本人姓名为张俊华，现年22岁，籍贯四川，居住于嵩山路宋厚里（Sung Hou Li）28号，自四月中旬起一直居住于此。本人于1932年首次来到上海，此后直至最近一直居住在吴淞。

5月1日，本人与其他“人民自救抗侮协会”成员一同前往南市公共游乐场，途中在威赛司路与索伯恩路转角处被捕。本人不是中国共产党党员，也不知道谁持有共产主义文献。

签署：张俊华。

pages.en:
Zao Ying Hwa. 赵映华 ✓
Hupeh.                                          D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.           3.5.33.                 Clerk Van.

My name is Zao Ying Hwa, a ged 20, native of hupeh,
residing at no fixed abode. I first came to Shanghai about
2 years ago but returned to my native place after six
months. I returned to Shanghai on April 26 and until May 1
was residing at a hotel in the French Concession, the name
of which I have forgotten.
    On May 1st I went to 28 Sung Mur Li, Sungpa Road
and left there with the other members to attend the mass
meeting at the Public Recreation Ground and was arrested
by the police at Wayside and Thorburn Rds corner.

                                        Signed: Zao Ying Hwa.
pages.zh:
赵映华。 ✓
湖北。                                          副督察长 Golder。
榆林路巡捕房           1933年5月3日。                 书记员 Van。

我叫赵映华，20岁，湖北人，居无定所。我大约两年前初次来到上海，但在六个月后返回了家乡。我于4月26日回到上海，直至5月1日一直居住在法租界的一家旅馆，旅馆名称我已忘记。
    5月1日，我前往松潘路宋家里28号，随后与其他成员一同离开，去参加在公共游乐场举行的群众大会，并在韦思德路与索伯恩路转角处被警察逮捕。

                                        签名：赵映华。

pages.en:
Yang Nich Sung (杨新松)
Canton                                      D.S.I.  Goldor
Hongkong Stn.      5-5-33                   Clerk for Chia Tsing.

My name is Yang Nich Sung 杨新松, age 21,
native of Canton, born at Kuala Lumpa, F.M.S. I am
a British subject. I first attended the Christian
Mission School in Kuala Lumpa for a period of three
years. At the age of nine I left and entered the Tsung
Wong (worshipping Confucius) School in Kuala Lumpa.
I stayed there for four years and then attended the
Chinese High School in Singapore, where I remained
for four years. When I was fifteen my father gave
me a birth certificate which he told me was proof
that I was a British Subject. Soon after he told
me that I had better go to China to finish my education.
To facilitate this a friend of my father's named 'Ling'
obtained a Chinese passport from the Chinese Consul
General in Singapore. In 1927 I left Singapore and
entered the Amoy University where I studied mathematics
Chinese and English. Whilst there I lost both my passport
and birth certificate, I don't know the number of either.
After I had been in Amoy for about 2 years, a friend
named Chen (陈) who was attending the Zih Kei Middle
School told me that I could obtain a better education
in Shanghai. Upon my arrival in Shanghai I took a
room at an hotel on the French Bund and stayed there
for about 4 days. Having decided to study at the
Chinese University, I removed there and occupied school
quarters. Just before the occupation of Mukden, Sept. 18,
1931, I went to Peiping and started private study at
pages.zh:
杨新松 (Yang Nich Sung)
广东                                      副督察长 Goldor
香港巡捕房      1933年5月5日                   Chia Tsing 的书记员。

我叫杨新松，21岁，广东人，出生于马来联邦（F.M.S.）吉隆坡。我是英国臣民。我最初在吉隆坡的基督教传教士学校就读三年。九岁时我离校，进入吉隆坡的宗孔学校（尊孔学校）。我在那里待了四年，然后进入新加坡的中华中学，在那里又读了四年。十五岁时，父亲给了我一份出生证明，他告诉我这是证明我是英国臣民的证据。不久后他告诉我，最好去中国完成学业。为了方便此事，我父亲的一位名叫“Ling”的朋友从新加坡的中国总领事馆那里获得了一本中国护照。1927年我离开新加坡，进入厦门大学，学习数学、中文和英文。在那里期间，我丢失了护照和出生证明，我不记得两者的号码。我在厦门待了大约两年后，一位就读于志基中学（音译）的朋友陈（Chen）告诉我，在上海我可以接受更好的教育。抵达上海后，我在法外滩的一家旅馆租了一个房间，住了大约4天。决定在中国大学学习后，我搬到了那里并住在校舍里。就在1931年9月18日沈阳沦陷前夕，我前往北平，开始在

pages.en:
- 2 -
the house of a friend named Ling Vung Tsoong 林文忠
at Chen Jong Fu 陈宗甫, Peiping. I stayed until
September 1932 then I joined the medical corps of
the North Eastern Volunteer Armies. In February
1933 I was wounded at Hingtskow (兴子沟), Jehol,
and returned to Peiping where I remained till
March 25, on which date I set sail for Shanghai.
Upon my arrival here I went to live with a friend named
Tsung Ming Tao (曾明道) at No.185 Szechuen Road.
Later I obtained a room at No.7 Peace Terrace,
Avenue Joffre which I shared with a friend named
Tong Vung Boong who is studying law at the Chinese
University. I am a member of the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult and was
arrested on May 1, as I was proceeding together with
the members from the Northern Branch at No.189
Tien Feh Li, Range Road, to the Public Recreation
Ground, Zantse. I am not a communist nor have I
ever been one. If you wish to communicate with
my father the address is: Yang Boon Yao, Sin Leong
Fatt, 103 Java Street, Kuala Lumpur.

(signed) Yang Bich Sung
pages.zh:
- 2 -
北平陈宗甫处一位名叫林文忠（Ling Vung Tsoong）的朋友家中私下学习。我一直待到1932年9月，随后加入了东北义勇军的医疗队。1933年2月，我在热河兴子沟（Hingtskow）受伤，返回北平，一直待到3月25日，当天我乘船前往上海。抵达这里后，我去四川路185号与一位名叫曾明道（Tsung Ming Tao）的朋友同住。后来我在霞飞路和平里7号租了一个房间，与一位在中国大学攻读法律的朋友 Tong Vung Boong（音译）合住。我是民众自救抗辱会的成员，5月1日，当我与该会北区支部（位于兰路天妃里189号）的成员一同前往闸北公共游乐场时被捕。我不是共产党员，也从未加入过共产党。如果您希望与我父亲联系，地址是：Yang Boon Yao, Sin Leong Fatt, 103 Java Street, Kuala Lumpur。

(签名) Yang Bich Sung

pages.en:
7

Wong Sau Ching (王秀清)
Meihsien, Kwangtung                                A.B. 38860
Singe Station        4-5-33                        Clerk Liao Tseng Hien

Wong Sau Ching, age 17, native of Meihsien (梅县),
Kwangtung. At the age of 11, I commenced my education at a
primary school at Meihsien, remaining there for about 2½
years. Subsequently I studied at a middle school in Meihsien
and came to Shanghai about 3 years ago. On my arrival
here I studied at the Wen Yah (文法) College on Nanking
Road for 2 weeks. The college then closed shortly afterwards.
I was arrested by the Chinese Authorities in off North
Szechuen Road for being a reactionary, and was imprisoned
for 1 year and 8 months. After being released from gaol
I returned to my native place for one year.

On April 28, 1933 I returned to Shanghai and stayed
that night at the Dah Sung Lodging House on the corner of
Rue Chapsal and Rue Auguste Boppe, together with a friend
named Tsang Sush (张水). On April 29 and 30 I stayed at
a lodging house somewhere on Rue du Consulat. I cannot
remember the exact whereabouts of this lodging house.

On May 1st I was standing on Nanchow Road when
the police arrested me.

(signed) Wong Sau Ching

Interpreter's Note
The address mentioned was visited and proved to
be false.
pages.zh:
7

王秀清 (Wong Sau Ching)
广东梅县                                A.B. 38860
辛格巡捕房        1933年5月4日                        书记员 Liao Tseng Hien

王秀清，17岁，广东梅县人。11岁时，我在梅县的一所小学开始受教育，在那里待了大约两年半。随后我在梅县的一所中学学习，大约三年前来到上海。抵达这里后，我在南京路的文法学院学习了两周。该学院随后不久关闭。我因被中国当局认定为反动分子而在北四川路附近被捕，并被监禁了一年零八个月。出狱后，我返回家乡一年。

1933年4月28日，我回到上海，当晚与一位名叫张水（Tsang Sush）的朋友一起住在沙尔萨路（Rue Chapsal）和奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）转角的大松旅社。4月29日和30日，我住在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）某处的一个旅社。我不记得该旅社的确切位置。

5月1日，我正站在南昌路上时被警察逮捕。

(签名) 王秀清

译者注
经走访，上述地址被证实为虚假。

pages.en:
Zung Pao Bing (陈保平)。
Chekiang.                                      D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.           3.5.33.                Clerk Van Ti Foo.

My name is Zung Pao sing, aged 24, native of Zaoshing,
residing at 18 Sing Hwa Faung, Yenshan Road.    I was born
at Zaoshing and came to Shanghai in August 1932. I came to
Shanghai to learn the silk manufacturing business. I am not a
member of the communist party nor a member of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult. On the morning
of May 1st, 1933 I left my lodgings at Yenshan Rd together with
a fellow countryman named Sung Kong Ling and was proceeding
to the Hua Li Silk Filature, Ward Road to find work. When we
arrived at the corner of Wayside and Thorburn Rd we saw a crowd
of people. My friend approached the crowd but I stood on the
corner. Almost immediately a party of police arrived and the
crowd ran towards me, a foreign officer ran up to me and arrested
me. At that time I had nothing in my possession except a few
coppers and do not know why I was arrested.

                                              Signed: Zung Pao sing.
pages.zh:
陈保平 (Zung Pao Bing)。
浙江。                                      副督察长 Golder。
榆林路巡捕房           1933年5月3日。                书记员 Van Ti Foo。

我叫 Zung Pao sing，24岁，绍兴人，居住在延山路兴华坊18号。我出生于绍兴，于1932年8月来到上海。我来上海是为了学习丝绸制造业务。我不是共产党员，也不是民众自救抗辱会的成员。1933年5月1日上午，我与一位名叫宋孔令（Sung Kong Ling，音译）的同乡一起离开延山路的住所，前往华德路华利缫丝厂找工作。当我们到达韦思德路和索伯恩路转角时，看到一群人。我的朋友走近人群，但我站在转角处。几乎立刻，一队警察赶到，人群向我跑来，一名外籍警官跑过来逮捕了我。当时我身上除了一些铜板外没有任何物品，我不知道为什么被捕。

                                              签名：Zung Pao sing。

pages.en:
Sung Chih Fong (宋潔芳)
Canton                                      D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.             3/5/33               Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Sung Chih Fong, female, age 20, native
of Canton residing at 1110 Chenju Station Road, O.O.L.
I am a student of the Ming Hwa (民華) Middle
School, North Szechuen Road.
I joined the Association to Resist Insult at the
beginning of April and was appointed to attend to the cleri-
cal work at the Eastern District Branch Office. On May 1st
I went to the Eastern Branch Office at 7 a.m. and heard some-
one say that the Police had examined the pamphlets and that
they were in order. I have perused many of the pamphlets
etc., issued by the Association and have noticed that it al-
ways bore the Association chop. I have never seen any li-
terature of a communistic nature, and am certain that none
was bundled by the Eastern Branch Office. After leaving the
office on May 1st I proceeded to Thorburn Road and joined
the procession when I was arrested.

(Sd.) Sung Chih Fong.
pages.zh:
宋洁芳 (Sung Chih Fong)
广东                                      督察长 Sansom
榆林路巡捕房             1933年5月3日               书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

我叫宋洁芳，女，20岁，广东人，居住在欧战纪念路（O.O.L.）真如站路1110号。我是北四川路民华中学的学生。
我在四月初加入了抗辱会，并被指派负责东区办事处的文书工作。5月1日早上7点，我去了东区办事处，听到有人说警察已经检查了宣传册，认为没有问题。我查阅过该会发行的许多宣传册等，注意到上面总是盖有该会的印章。我从未见过任何具有共产主义性质的文献，并且确信东区办事处没有捆绑过此类文献。5月1日离开办事处后，我前往索伯恩路，加入游行队伍时被捕。

(签名) 宋洁芳。

pages.en:
Complaint No 9
Statement

Zung Tsoong Kyau (陳鐘覺),
Yien-zung, Kompo.          D.S. Kourjansky,
Yulin Road      3-5-33     Clerk Chiang Tou Hua

My name is Zung Tsoong Kyau, age 37, M/teacher, native of
Yien-zung, Kompo, residing at No.75, Lane 2365 Y'poo Road.
I came to Shanghai 3 years ago. At present I am a □□□□
master of a private primary school situated at the aforementioned
address.
I have no connection with "Self Salvation Association to
resist insult" and I am not a communist.

Signed: Zung Tsoong Kyau.
pages.zh:
投诉编号 9
陈述

陈钟觉 (Zung Tsoong Kyau),
江西赣州。          督察长 Kourjansky,
榆林路      1933年5月3日     书记员 Chiang Tou Hua

我叫陈钟觉，37岁，男，教师，江西赣州人，居住在亿宝路2365弄75号。我三年前来到上海。目前我是位于上述地址的一所私立小学的□□□□校长。
我与“民众自救抗辱会”没有任何联系，我也不是共产党员。

签名：陈钟觉。

pages.en:
Wong Hoo. 黄滸
Fokien. D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn. 3.5.33. Clerk Vnn.

My name is Wong Hoo, aged 44, native of Fokien,
residing at 22S Canton Road. I am married and unemployed.
I was born at Ting Chow Hsien (汀州), Fokien where I worked
as a merchant. I came to Shanghai in the beginning of March
this year in order to search for employment and since my arrival
here I have been unable to find work. On the afternoon of
May 1st I went to 28 Sung Mur Li, Sungpan Road to find a
fellow countryman named Chang, where I was arrested. I know
nothing about my arrest. I am not affiliated with any political
party. I am not a communist.

Signed: Wong Hoo.
pages.zh:
黄滸 (Wong Hoo)。
福建。 副督察长 Golder。
榆林路巡捕房 1933年5月3日。 书记员 Vnn。

我叫黄滸，44岁，福建人，居住在广东路22S号。我已婚，失业。我出生于福建汀州县，在那里经商。今年三月初，我来上海寻找工作，自抵达这里以来一直未能找到工作。5月1日下午，我前往松潘路宋家里28号寻找一位姓张的同乡，在那里被捕。我对被捕一事一无所知。我不隶属于任何政党。我不是共产党员。

签名：黄滸。

pages.en:
Soo Wei Chi (苏惠奇).
Moulmien.                                      D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.        3.5.33.                    Clerk Van.

My name is Soo Wei Chi, aged 22, native of Moulmien.
From the age 7 to 17 I studied in the Hway Sitt(    ) Middle
School at Moulmein . At 17 of age I went to Amoy where I
studied in the Tsih Mei Middle for three years. In 1931 I came
to Shanghai and entered the middle school department of the
Great China University, Chungshan Road, Chapei, where I am still
studying. On March 9 I read in the newspapers of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult and its formation
by Madame Sun Yat Sen and Wu Hai. At the end of March I
went to Wu Hai's house in French Concession and registered
as a member. On April 28 I received a notification from the
association that a mass meeting was to be held on the Public
Recreation Ground on May 1st. I went to No.15 I Yuen Li, Carter
Rd at 10 a.m. and stayed there until I was arrested. When the
police arrived we were discussing ways and means of effecting
the release of the members of the association who had been
arrested in Nantao and in/the Settlement. We arrived at no
decision. I am not a member of the communist party nor have
I had any dealings with any members.

Signed: Soo Wei Chi.
pages.zh:
苏惠奇 (Soo Wei Chi)。
毛淡棉。                                      副督察长 Golder。
榆林路巡捕房        1933年5月3日。                    书记员 Van。

我叫苏惠奇，22岁，毛淡棉人。从7岁到17岁，我在毛淡棉的 Hway Sitt(    ) 中学学习。17岁时我前往厦门，在集美中学学习了三年。1931年我来到上海，进入闸北中山路大夏大学中学部学习，至今仍在那里就读。3月9日，我在报纸上读到关于民众自救抗辱会及其由孙逸仙夫人和吴海组建的消息。三月底，我前往法租界吴海的住所，注册成为会员。4月28日，我收到该会通知，将于5月1日在公共游乐场举行群众大会。我上午10点前往卡特路伊元里15号，并一直待在那里直到被捕。警察到达时，我们正在讨论如何营救在南市和租界被捕的协会会员的方法。我们未达成任何决定。我不是共产党员，也与任何党员没有任何往来。

签名：苏惠奇。

pages.en:
Lo Ming (羅明 )。
Szechuen.                                          D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.           3.5.33.                    Clerk Van.

My name is Lo Ming, aged 22, native of Szechuen, single,
residing at No.1 Dung Hun Li, Rue DuBosc, French Concession.
I arrived from Yi Ping, Szechuen, where I have been studying
some 2 months ago and went to reside at the above address. From
time of my arrival about one month ago I was without a job.
On March 9 I read the formation of the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult from the newspapers
and I went to the home of Wu Hai (吳海 ) at 48 Route Vallon on
the following day and became a member of the movement. I was
given a staff position being entrusted with the printing of
handbills, which was done at No.2 Tai Li Li, Markham Road.
For this work I was promised $19 per month. The printing plant
which comprised a duplicator was removed to No.15 I Yoen Li,
Carter Road on March 29 and was seized by the Police on May 1.
My wages were paid by Woo Moh Tien(        ), a teacher of the
Chinese University, Chenju, whom I met at Markham Road.
On May 1 I went to No.15 I Yoen Li, Carter Road at 9 a.m.
with the idea of proceeding to the Public Recreation Ground,
Nantao, to attend the mass meeting scheduled for 12 or 2 p.m.
We heard that the meeting was stopped by the Chinese authorities
and decided not to proceed. We heard that some of our members
had been arrested by the Chinese and Settlement Police. We were
on the point of holding a meeting in No.15 I Yoen Li, Carter Rd
when the police arrived and we were arrested. So far as I know
Ling Tsong Ko, who was arrested in the upstairs room of No.15
I Yoen Li, Carter Rd, is not a member of the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult. I am not a member of the
Communist Party nor have I even had anything to do with the
movement.
                                        Signed: Lo Ming.
pages.zh:
罗明 (Lo Ming )。
四川。                                          副督察长 Golder。
榆林路巡捕房           1933年5月3日。                    书记员 Van。

我叫罗明，22岁，四川人，单身，居住在法租界杜波司路敦厚里1号。我两个月前从正在求学的四川宜宾来到此处，并住进上述地址。自大约一个月前抵达以来，我一直没有工作。
3月9日，我从报纸上读到民众自救抗辱会成立的消息，第二天我前往瓦隆路48号吴海（吳海）的家中，成为了该运动的一员。我被安排担任职员职务，负责印刷传单，印刷工作在马克姆路泰利里2号进行。为此工作，我被告知月薪为19元。包括一台油印机在内的印刷设备于3月29日搬迁至卡特路伊元里15号，并于5月1日被警察查封。我的工资由吴莫田（Woo Moh Tien，音译）支付，他是中国大学真如校区的一名教师，我是在马克姆路认识他的。
5月1日，我上午9点前往卡特路伊元里15号，打算前往南市公共游乐场参加预定在中午12点或下午2点举行的群众大会。我们听说会议被中国当局叫停，决定不再前往。我们听说我们的一些成员已被中国和租界警察逮捕。正当我们准备在卡特路伊元里15号召开会议时，警察到达，我们被捕。据我所知，在卡特路伊元里15号楼上房间被捕的林宗科（Ling Tsong Ko，音译）并不是民众自救抗辱会的成员。我不是共产党员，甚至与该运动没有任何关系。
                                        签名：罗明。

pages.en:
Zung Tong Nyoen(陳登元).
Zangchow, Kiangsu. D.S.I. Goldar.
Yulin Rd Stn. 3.5.33. Clerk Van Ti Foo.

My name is Zung Tong Nyoen, aged 23, native of
Zangchow, Kiangsu, single, student of the Shanghai College of
Law, Route Prosper Paris, residing at No.37 Haig Li, Avenue
Haig, French Concession. I came to Shanghai from Zangchow
in 1928 and entered the Tung Chi College, Woosong where I
remained for three years. I then entered the Law College.
About one month ago I heard that one of my teachers Zung Chun
Sz was a member of the People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist Insult and after discussing the matter with him I
decided to join the law college branch situated at 19 Ming
Tuh Li, Avenue Joffre of the association on April 3. On
May 1 I went to No.15 I Yuen Li, Carter Road together with
others at 11.a.m. with the intention of going to the mass
meeting but was arrested by the police. When the police
arrived my friends and I were making enquiries regarding
the arrest of the members of the association.

Sig. ed: Zung Tong Nyoen.
pages.zh:
Zung Tong Nyoen（陳登元）。
江苏常州。D.S.I. Goldar。
榆林路站。33年5月3日。书记员 Van Ti Foo。

本人名为 Zung Tong Nyoen，现年23岁，籍贯江苏常州，未婚，上海法政学院学生，校址位于霞飞路，寓所位于法租界海格路海格里37号。我于1928年从常州来到上海，进入吴淞同济学院就读，在那里待了三年。随后我进入法政学院。大约一个月前，我听说我的一位老师 Zung Chun Sz 是“抗日救国会”的成员，在与他讨论此事后，我决定于4月3日加入该会设在霞飞路明德里19号的法学院分部。5月1日上午11时，我与他人一同前往卡德路怡元里15号，打算参加群众大会，但被警察逮捕。当警察到达时，我和朋友们正在询问关于该会成员被捕的事宜。

签名：Zung Tong Nyoen。

pages.en:
Woo Pah Kwei (吴伯揆).
Kweichow.                                      D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.          3.5.3.                  Clerk Van.

My name is Woo pah Kwei, a ged 34, natige of Kweichow,
single, clerk, residing a t the Qi Kong General Store, corner
of Chungkiang and Weihaiwei Raa da/ For the past 2 years
I have been employed as a teacher in the 'Liang' (    )
family, 48 Hsi Ming Lou Kah, Kweiyang. I came to Shanghai at
the end of March 1933 to find a job owing to the pupils in
my charge leaving for school. I had a letter from
a friend nam ed Zung (  ) to Mr. See Moh Tien, a teacher of
the Futan University and a member of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult. Upon my arrival
he offered me the job as a secretary to the association at a
salary of $27 per month. At the time I joined the association
was situated in the home of Wu Mai but later removed to
the Sung Li Restaurant at No.309 Avenue Dubail. After
remaining there for 6 days we moved to No.2 Tai Li Li, Markham
Rd and lastly to No.15 I Yoen Li, Carter Rd. I was at the
last named address in order to attend the mass meeting at
the Public Recreation Ground. At about 12 noon the police
arrived and/were arrested.

Signed: Woo Pah Kwei.
pages.zh:
Woo Pah Kwei（吴伯揆）。
贵州。                                      D.S.I. Golder。
榆林路站。          33年5月3日。                  书记员 Van。

本人名为 Woo Pah Kwei，现年34岁，籍贯贵州，未婚，职员，寓所位于九江路与威海卫路转角处的启康百货店。过去两年，我在贵阳西门楼街48号“梁”（    ）家担任教师。由于我负责的学生离校上学，我于1933年3月底来到上海寻找工作。我持有一封朋友 Zung（  ）写给复旦大学教师、“抗日救国会”成员 See Moh Tien 先生的信。抵达后，他为我提供了该会秘书的职位，月薪27元。在我加入该会时，会址位于 Wu Mai 家中，后来迁至杜美路309号松利餐厅。在那里停留6天后，我们搬至麦高包路泰利里2号，最后搬至卡德路怡元里15号。我在上述最后一个地址是为了参加在公共游乐场举行的群众大会。中午12点左右，警察到达，我和其他人被捕。

签名：Woo Pah Kwei。

pages.en:
Ling Ming Liu (林民柳).
Fokien                                D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.          3/5/33            Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

    My name is Ling Ming Liu, age 22, native of Fo-
kien, residing at 30 Rue Pere Robert. I am a student of
the Hsin Hwa Fine Arts School, French Concession.
    I joined the Association to Resist Insult on
April 20, but did not attend any meetings until May 1st
when I was arrested at Carter Road. I saw a notice posted
in our school which urged us to join the Association to
further its patriotic aims, and thus became a member.

                            (Sd.) Ling Ming Liu.
pages.zh:
Ling Ming Liu（林民柳）。
福建                                D.S. Sansom
榆林路站。          33年5月3日            书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

    本人名为 Ling Ming Liu，现年22岁，籍贯福建，寓所位于罗别特神父路30号。我是法租界新华艺术学校的学生。
    我于4月20日加入“抗日救国会”，但在5月1日之前未参加任何会议，当天我在卡德路被捕。我看到学校里张贴的一张告示，敦促我们加入该会以推进其爱国目标，因此成为会员。

                            （签名）Ling Ming Liu。

pages.en:
Zung Ping Chiu. 陈苹秋
D.S.I. Golder.
Kwangsi.
Yulin Rd Stn.    3.5.33.    Clerk Van.

My name is Zung Ping Chiu, aged 21, native of
Kwangsi, single student, residing at No.17 Dah :oo Faung,
Av: du Roi Albert, French Concession. I came to Shanghai in
1932 and since then I have studied at the Sing Hwa Middle
School, Tang :oo Jao, French Concession. On May 1st I went
to 15 I Yoen Li, Carter Road to attend a meeting of the
People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult when
I was arrested by the police. I am not a member of the
Communist Party nor have I any connection with the Communist
Party.

Signed: Zung Ping Chiu.
pages.zh:
Zung Ping Chiu. 陈苹秋
D.S.I. Golder。
广西。
榆林路站。    33年5月3日。    书记员 Van。

本人名为 Zung Ping Chiu，现年21岁，籍贯广西，未婚学生，寓所位于法租界亚尔培帝路大洋房17号。我于1932年来到上海，此后一直在法租界唐高兆的新华中学读书。5月1日，我去卡德路怡元里15号参加“抗日救国会”的会议时被警察逮捕。我不是共产党员，也与共产党没有任何联系。

签名：Zung Ping Chiu。

pages.en:
Teng Lai Fe (许来非)
Szechuen                                D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.      3/5/33                  Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Teng Lai Fe, age 20, native of Sze-
chuen, residing at 62 Rue Albert, educated in Szechuen in
a middle school. I have been in Shanghai since Dec., 1932
and have been unemployed ever since; having been supported
by my mother in Szechuen.
    I joined the Association to Resist Insult on
March 19th and attended my first meeting on May 1st at
Carter Road headquarters where I was arrested. I have
only a little knowledge of the activities of the Associa-
tion.

                                    (Sd.) Teng Lai Fe.
pages.zh:
Teng Lai Fe（许来非）
四川                                D.S. Sansom
榆林路站。      33年5月3日                  书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

本人名为 Teng Lai Fe，现年20岁，籍贯四川，寓所位于亚尔培路62号，曾在四川的一所中学受教育。我自1932年12月以来一直在上海，此后一直失业；由我在四川的母亲供养。
    我于3月19日加入“抗日救国会”，并于5月1日在卡德路总部参加了我的第一次会议，在那里我被捕。我对该会的活动知之甚少。

                                    （签名）Teng Lai Fe。

pages.en:
Szechuen
Yulin Stn.    3/5/33

Qo Maung Choh (官夢昌).
D.S. Sansom
Clerk Chao Shih-chow •

My name is Qo Maung Choh, student, age 19, native
of Szechuen, residing at 32 Rue Pere Robert.

I joined the Association to Resist Insult on March
22. On May 1st I attended my first meeting at Carter Road
Headquarters where I was arrested. I was an ordinary mem-
ber and did not take any active part in the work.

(Sd.) Qo Maung Choh.
pages.zh:
四川
榆林路站。    33年5月3日

Qo Maung Choh（官夢昌）。
D.S. Sansom
书记员 Chao Shih-chow •

本人名为 Qo Maung Choh，学生，现年19岁，籍贯四川，寓所位于罗别特神父路32号。

我于3月22日加入“抗日救国会”。5月1日，我在卡德路总部参加了我的第一次会议，在那里我被捕。我只是一名普通会员，并未积极参与工作。

（签名）Qo Maung Choh。

pages.en:
Cheng Siang (張湘)

Canton                                      D.S. Sansom
Yulin R'd      May 3. 33                    Chao Chih Chow

My name is Cheng Liang, M/female, age 22, native of
Canton, residing at 81 Yoong Chih Li, Sue wants.
    About a month ago my husband, Li Chiang, told me that
an Association to resist insult had been founded by
Madame Sun Yat Sen to combat Japanese influence in China
    On May 1st. I heard that a number of the Association
members had been arrested, so I went to the Carter Road
headquarters to enquire for my husband who is a member
of the Association. My husband is unemployed; he being
the ex-editor of the "Far Eastern" newspaper which was
compelled to cease publication two months ago on account
of business depression.

                                        Signed : Cheng Siang.
pages.zh:
Cheng Siang（張湘）

广东                                      D.S. Sansom
榆林路      33年5月3日                    Chao Chih Chow

本人名为 Cheng Liang，女，现年22岁，籍贯广东，寓所位于苏瓦特永志里81号。
    大约一个月前，我的丈夫 Li Chiang 告诉我，孙夫人成立了一个“抗日救国会”，以对抗日本在中国的影响。
    5月1日，我听说该会多名成员被捕，于是前往卡德路总部打听我丈夫的消息，他是该会成员。我丈夫失业；他曾是《远东》报的前编辑，该报因商业萧条于两个月前被迫停刊。

                                        签名：Cheng Siang。

pages.en:
Soo Tsung Mei (孫中会)
Canton                                      D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.             3/5/33               Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Soo Tsung Mei, female, age 16, native
of Canton, residing off Rue De Soeurs.
    On April 30, I heard a lecturer in Chapel state
that an Association to Resist Insult had been promoted by
Madame Sun Yat-sen to further anti-Japanese activities, so
I joined the Range Road Branch Office.
    On May 1st I proceeded from the Range Road Branch
Office and to the headquarters in Carter Road where I was
arrested.

                                    (Sd.) Soo Tsung Mei(
pages.zh:
Soo Tsung Mei（孫中会）
广东                                      D.S. Sansom
榆林路站。             33年5月3日               书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

本人名为 Soo Tsung Mei，女，现年16岁，籍贯广东，寓所位于修女路附近。
    4月30日，我听到一位讲师在教堂说，孙夫人发起成立了“抗日救国会”以推进反日活动，于是我加入了兰路分部。
    5月1日，我从兰路分部前往卡德路总部，在那里我被捕。

                                    （签名）Soo Tsung Mei(

pages.en:
Soong An (宋安).
Kiangsu                                D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.          3/5/33             Clark Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Soong An, age 26, native of Kiangsu,
residing at 162A Avenue Foch. I am a teacher employed at
the Loh Hwa Girls School at 162A Avenue Foch.
        I joined the Association to Resist Insult during
March.
        On May 1st, I went to the headquarters at 15 I-
Yoen Li to report that a number of members had been arrested
on Avenue Road that morning. We then planned a method of
assisting the arrested persons. I have never attended any
meetings of the Association, but was given to understand
that the motives of same were purely patriotic.

                                (Sd.)    Soong An.
pages.zh:
Soong An（宋安）。
江苏                                D.S. Sansom
榆林路站。          33年5月3日             书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

本人名为 Soong An，现年26岁，籍贯江苏，寓所位于福煦路162A号。我是受雇于福煦路162A号洛华女中的教师。
        我于3月期间加入“抗日救国会”。
        5月1日，我去怡元里15号总部报告当天上午在爱文义路有多名成员被捕的情况。随后我们策划了援助被捕人员的方法。我从未参加过该会的任何会议，但据我了解，其动机纯粹是爱国的。

                                （签名）    Soong An。

pages.en:
Zung Tsing (程正).
Peiping                                D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.          3/5/33             Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Zung Tsing, age 23, native of Peiping,
residing in the French Concession. I am employed as a
teacher in Wen Hwa Middle School, Kiangwan. I joined the
Association to Resist Insult during March because of its
patriotic character.
        On May 1st I went to Wu Mai's residence in the
French Concession, and was told by him to go to 15 I-Yoen
Li, Cartar Road, to enquire whether Madame Sun Yat-sen was
there. On my arrival there I met a number of members of
the Association and joined them in a meeting to protest
against the arrest of a number of members by the Municipal
Police that morning.
        I have never heard communistic affairs discussed
at the meeting of the Association and our motives are pure-
ly patriotic.

                        (Sd.) Zung Tsing.
pages.zh:
Zung Tsing（程正）。
北平                                D.S. Sansom
榆林路站。          33年5月3日             书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

本人名为 Zung Tsing，现年23岁，籍贯北平，寓所位于法租界。我是江湾文华中学的教师。我于3月期间因其爱国性质而加入“抗日救国会”。
        5月1日，我去了法租界 Wu Mai 的住所，他让我去卡德路怡元里15号，询问孙夫人是否在那里。到达那里后，我遇到了该会的多名成员，并与他们一起开会，抗议当天上午工部局警察逮捕多名成员的行为。
        我从未在该会的会议上听到过讨论共产主义事务，我们的动机纯粹是爱国的。

                        （签名）Zung Tsing。

pages.en:
Ling Wei Pang 林渭浜
D.S. Sansom
Kansu
Yulin Road May 3, 1933 Chao Kyih Chow

My name is Ling Wei Pang, (林渭浜 ) age 32,
native of Kansu, residing at 370 North Shanse Road, and
employed as an assistant at the Tai Shing Chong (泰興昌)
Tailoring Shop at Pekien Road.
On May 1st. I went to 15 I yoen Li, Carter Road, to
join the Association to Resist Insult. Shortly after my
arrival there the police raided the place and arrested me.
I was persuaded to join the Association by
reputable friends of mine because of its patriotic aims.

Signed; Ling Wei Pang
pages.zh:
Ling Wei Pang 林渭浜
D.S. Sansom
甘肃
榆林路 1933年5月3日 Chao Kyih Chow

本人名为 Ling Wei Pang，（林渭浜）现年32岁，籍贯甘肃，寓所位于山西北路370号，受雇于北江西路泰興昌裁缝店担任助手。
5月1日，我去卡德路怡元里15号加入“抗日救国会”。到达后不久，警察搜查了该处并将我逮捕。我是因该会的爱国目标而被我的 reputable friends（原文不清/可敬的朋友）说服加入该会的。

签名；Ling Wei Pang

pages.en:
Ling Tsong Ko (林家可)
Fokien                                      D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.          3/5/33                  Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Ling Tsong Ko, age 41, native of Fokien,
residing in an upstairs front room, over the Headquarters of
the Association to Resist Insult, at 15 I-Yeen Li, Carter
Road.    I am a teacher employed by Chi Sze University, Kiang-
wan Road.

    I am not a member of the Association to Resist
Insult.  When the Police raided this address on May 1st, I
was arrested in my room.  I did not attend the Association
meeting xxxxxxxxxxxx downstairs.

    In my room the Police found a number of books
dealing with Soviet economics.  My reasons for having pos-
session of these books is that the Education Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai had invited me to undertake
the study of this subject with a view to dissuading pupils
of the University from becoming imbued with Soviet ideas.
Letters from the Education Bureau, written by Pan Fung Chien,
the Chief of the Bureau, are at my home.

Interrogator's Note
    The letters referred to above were not found by
the Police.

                                    (Sd.) Ling Tseng Ko.
pages.zh:
Ling Tsong Ko（林家可）
福建                                      D.S. Sansom
榆林路站。          33年5月3日                  书记员 Chao Shih-chow。

本人名为 Ling Tsong Ko，现年41岁，籍贯福建，寓所位于卡德路怡元里15号“抗日救国会”总部楼上的前间。我是江湾路之江大学的教师。

    我不是“抗日救国会”的成员。5月1日警察搜查该地址时，我在房间里被捕。我没有参加楼下 xxxxxxxxxxxx 的协会会议。

    警察在我的房间里发现了一些关于苏联经济学的书籍。我拥有这些书籍的原因是，大上海市政府教育局邀请我研究这一课题，旨在劝阻大学生不受苏联思想的影响。教育局局长潘凤谦（音译）写的来自教育局的信件在我家里。

审讯员注
    警方未发现上述信件。

                                    （签名）Ling Tseng Ko。

Canton
Yulin Stn.           3/5/33

My name is Zung Yien Chiu, age 22, native of

I am a student of the Fine Arts College, Nantao.
        I joined the Association to Resist Insult a
week ago but did not attend any meetings until May 1st,
when I was arrested. I joined the Association because of
patriotic character.

                                (Sd.) Zung Yien Chiu.

        我于一周前加入“抗日救国会”，但在5月1日之前未参加任何会议，当天我被捕。我因该会的爱国性质而加入。

                                （签名）Zung Yien Chiu。

I went to 15 I Yeen Li, Carter Rd on May 1st to attend a mass
meeting convened by the People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist Insult and was arrested by the police. I do not
know anything about the Communist Party.

Signed: Sung Yong Zeng.

上海。                                D.S.I. Golder。
榆林路站。      33年5月3日               书记员 Van。

本人名为 Sung Yong Zeng，现年24岁，籍贯上海。无业，寓所位于渡轮路附近的一间无门牌号的棚屋。我出生在上海。我没上过学。5月1日，我去卡德路怡元里15号参加由“抗日救国会”召集的群众大会，被警察逮捕。我对共产党一无所知。

签名：Sung Yong Zeng。

pages.en:
Yue Zung Taung (余慶湯)。
Canton.                                D.S.I. Golder.
Yulin Rd Stn.      3/5/33/             Clerk Van.

My name is Yue Zung Taung, aged 17, native of Canton,
student, residing at a certain house off Connaught Rd the
number of which I can not remember. I first came to Shanghai
in 1931 and entered the Chao Kwang Middle School. I studied
there for one term and since then I have not studied. I am
waiting for money from home to return to Canton. On May 1st
I went to 15 I Yeen Li, Carter Rd to attend a meeting and
was arrested by the police. I am not a member of the Communist
Party nor have I any connection with that party.
pages.zh:
Yue Zung Taung（余慶湯）。
广东。                                D.S.I. Golder。
榆林路站。      33年5月3日/             书记员 Van。

本人名为 Yue Zung Taung，现年17岁，籍贯广东，学生，寓所位于康纳脱路附近某处，门牌号我已记不清。我于1931年首次来到上海，进入肇光中学。我在那里读了一个学期，此后便未再读书。我正在等待家里的汇款以便返回广东。5月1日，我去卡德路怡元里15号参加会议，被警察逮捕。我不是共产党员，也与该党没有任何联系。

pages.en:
Ye Tsung Hwa (葉宗華)
Kiangsu                                      D.S. Samson
Yulin Stn.           3/5/33                  Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Ye Tsung Hwa, age 40, native of Kiang-
su, residing at 32 Tung Sing Li, Ferry Road, I am a coolie,
but have been unemployed for a month on account of illness.
I am not a member of the Association to Resist
Insult. On May 1st I went to 15 I-Yoen Li, Carter Road,
to see what the people there were doing, when I was arrested.

(Sd.) Ye Tsung Hwa.
pages.zh:
葉宗華 (Ye Tsung Hwa)
江苏                                      D.S. Samson
榆林路捕房           1933年5月3日                  书记员赵士周 (Chao Shih-chow)。

本人叶宗华，40岁，江苏人，住斐伦路同兴里32号。我是苦力，但因病已失业一个月。
我不是“抗侮会”的成员。5月1日，我去卡特路怡元里15号看那里的人在做什么，随后被捕。

(签名) 叶宗华。

7.

Teng Yu Ming (许友明).
Szechuen                                  E.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.          3/5/33                Clerk Chao Shih-show.

My name is Teng Yu Ming, age 20, native of Sze-
chuen, residing at Yuen Lai Fong, Rue de Marche. I am a
student of the Shanghai Fine Arts College, Rue de Marchs.
    I joined the Association to Resist Insult during
March and have since attended two meetings, including the
one at Carter Road where I was arrested. I am anti-Japanese
and opposed to communism.

                                    (Sd.) Teng Yu Ming.
pages.zh:
7.

四川                                  E.S. Sansom

本人许友明，20岁，四川人，住马浪路（Rue de Marche）源来坊。我是马浪路上海美术专科学校的学生。
    我在3月加入了“抗侮会”，此后参加过两次会议，包括我在卡特路被捕时参加的那一次。我反日且反对共产主义。

                                    (签名) 许友明。

Ze Teh lung (裕生荣)。
Kiangsi.                                D.S.I. Goldor.
Yulin Rd Stn.        3.5.33.            Clerk Van.

My name is Zi Teh lung, single student, aged 20,
native of Ki ngsi, residing at No.188 Avenue Road. I came
to Shanghai in July 1932 and took up studies at the Ying Kwong
Night School. I am at present at the Tax Office of the
Finance Department on Avenue Road near Ferry Road and have NO
connection with the Communist Party. On May 1st I went to 15
I Yoen Li, Carter Rd to attend a meeting of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult when I was
arrested by the police.

Signed: Zi Teh lung.
pages.zh:
裕生荣 (Ze Teh lung)。
江西                                D.S.I. Goldor.
榆林路捕房        1933.5.3.            书记员 Van。

本人 Zi Teh lung，单身，学生，20岁，江西人，住爱文义路188号。我于1932年7月来到上海，在英广夜校就读。我目前在爱文义路近斐伦路的财政局税务所工作，与共产党没有任何联系。5月1日，我去卡特路怡元里15号参加“人民自救抗侮会”的会议时被警察逮捕。

签名: Zi Teh lung。

Chang Chien Fang (張劍芳 )
Nanking D.S. Sansom
Yulin R'd May 2. 33 Chao Chih Chow

My name is Chang Chien Fang, Female, age 19,
native of Nanking, residing at 30 Yu Yang Li, Rue Paul Henry.
On May 1st. a girl friend of mine, named Li Yuen,
who, together with me, is a student of the Hsing Hwa Middle
School, Rue Pere Robert, informed me that the Association to
Resist Insult would hold a meeting at its headquarters, 15
I Yuen Li, Carter Road, and invited me to attend. I later
attended because of the patriotic activities of the Association
and was arrested .

Signed; (Chang Chien Fang)
pages.zh:
張劍芳 (Chang Chien Fang )
南京 D.S. Sansom
榆林路 1933年5月2日 赵志周 (Chao Chih Chow)

本人张剑芳，女，19岁，南京人，住亨利路（Rue Paul Henry）余阳里30号。
5月1日，我的女性朋友李瑗（Li Yuen）通知我，“抗侮会”将在其总部卡特路怡元里15号举行会议，并邀请我参加。她和我都是罗伯特神父路（Rue Pere Robert）兴华中学的学生。后来我因该会的爱国活动而前往参加，随即被捕。

签名; (张剑芳)

Hupeh

Yulin Road
May 3. 33
Chao Chih Chaw.

My name is Li Yuen, female, age 18, native of Hupeh
residing at the Hsing Hwa Middle School on Rue Pere Robert.
Chiang
On about April 24. a school-mate of mine, named "Chiang"
persuaded me to go to the headquarters of the Association
to Resist Insult. I was told that the Association had been
promoted by Madame Sun Yat Sen for a patriotic purpose so I
went to the meeting at the headquarters and was arrested,

Signed (李瑗) Li Nyoen
pages.zh:
李瑗 (Li Nyoen)
湖北
D.S. Sansom.
榆林路
1933年5月3日

蒋 (Chiang)
约4月24日，我的一位名叫“蒋”的同学劝我去“抗侮会”总部。我被告知该会是由孙逸仙夫人为了爱国目的而发起的，所以我去了总部的会议并在那里被捕。

签名 (李瑗) Li Nyoen

7
Chang Yih Fong 張逸芳
Fokien                                      D.S. Sansom.
Yulin R'd          May 3. 33                Chao Chih Chew

My name is Chang Yih Fong, female, age 19, native
of Fokien, residing at 67 Ming Tuh Li, Avenue J'och, student
of the Chow Kwong Middle School, Medhurst Road.
    A few days ago a man unknown to me came to our school
and stated that he was a member of the Association to Resist
Insult, which had been organised by prominent persons,
including Madame Sun Yat Sen and Tsai Yuen Pei, to promote
patriotism, and urged us to join the Association by reporting
to its headquarters on Carter Road on May 1st. On that day
one other girl accompanied me there and we were arrested.

                                Signed: Chang Yih Fong.
pages.zh:
7

福建                                      D.S. Sansom.

    几天前，一个我不认识的男子来到我们学校，声称他是“抗侮会”的成员，该会由孙逸仙夫人和蔡元培等知名人士组织，旨在弘扬爱国主义，并敦促我们于5月1日向卡特路总部报到以加入该会。当天，另一名女孩陪我前往，我们随即被捕。

                                签名: 张逸芳。

Zung Shao Tsung (陳少貞)
Fokien                                D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.          3/5/33            Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Zung Shao Tsung, female, age 14, native
of Fokien, residing at 3 Hai Ning Li, North Szechuen Road.
I am a student of Wen Hwa Middle School, Kiangwan Road.
    On May 1st I accompanied my cousin Lucie Loh (Loh
Sheu Tsung) to 15 I-Yeen Li, Carter Road and was arrested.

                                    (Sd.) Zung Shao Tsung.

福建                                D.S. Sansom

    5月1日，我陪同我的表妹 Lucie Loh (陆秀珍) 前往卡特路怡元里15号，随后被捕。

pages.en:
Ling She Chih (林希智).
Fokien                                      D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stan.             3/5/33              Clerk Chae Shih-chow.

    My name is Ling She Chih, female, age 17, native
of Fokien, residing at 67 Ming Tuh Li, Avenue Foch. I am
a student of the Chiu Kung (    ) Middle School, Medhurst
Road.
    About a week ago a male member of the Association
came to the school and informed us of the patriotic aims
of the Association to Resist Insult and mentioned the names
of members of well known people who were sponsoring the
movement. I learned that the headquarters of this Asso-
ciation were at 15 I-Yeen Li, Carter Road, so I proceeded

                                    (Sd.) Ling She Chih.
pages.zh:
林希智 (Ling She Chih).
福建                                      D.S. Sansom
榆林路捕房             1933年5月3日              书记员 Chae Shih-chow。

    本人林希智，女，17岁，福建人，住霞飞路明德里67号。我是麦特赫司脱路九公（原文不清）中学的学生。
    大约一周前，一名男性会员来到学校，向我们告知“抗侮会”的爱国宗旨，并提及赞助该运动的知名人士姓名。我得知该会总部设在卡特路怡元里15号，于是出于好奇于5月1日前往那里。

Lucie Loh (Loh Sheu Tsung) (陸秀珍)
Hunan                                          D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.           3/5/33                    Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Lucie Loh (Loh Sheu Tsung) female,
age 16, native of Hunan, residing at 16 Wongkashaw Gardens.
I am a student of Wen Hwa Middle School, Kiangwan Road.
During the afternoon of April 30, I was passing
along North Szechuen Road and heard a lecturer stated that
the Association to Resist Insult had been promoted by Madame
Sun Yat-sen to counter the Japanese influence in China.
The lecturer urged the audience to support the Association.
I considered the object of the Association was a worthy one
so I registered my name as a member.
On the morning of May 1st I went to the Range
Road Branch Office, and there proceeded to the I-Yoen Li
Headquarters, where I was arrested.

(Sd.) Loh Sheu Tsung.
pages.zh:
陸秀珍 (Lucie Loh (Loh Sheu Tsung))
湖南                                          D.S. Sansom
榆林路捕房           1933年5月3日                    书记员赵士周 (Chao Shih-chow)。

本人 Lucie Loh (陆秀珍)，女，16岁，湖南人，住王家沙花园16号。我是江湾路文华中学的学生。
4月30日下午，我路过北四川路时，听到一位演讲者称，“抗侮会”是由孙逸仙夫人发起的，旨在对抗日本在华影响力。
演讲者敦促听众支持该会。
我认为该会的目标是有价值的，所以我登记成为会员。
5月1日上午，我去了兰路分局，随后前往怡元里总部，在那里被捕。

(签名) 陆秀珍。

Hunan                                      D.S. Sansom
Yulin Stn.           3/5/33                Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

Hunan, residing at 16 Wongkashaw Gardens. I am a student
of the Wen Hwa (    ) Middle School, Kiangwan Road.
On May 1st I accompanied my sister Lucie Loh to
15 I-Yoen Li, Carter Road, and was arrested whilst listening
to other people's conversation.

                                          (Sd.) Loh Ying.
pages.zh:
陸瑛珍 (Loh Ying)
湖南                                      D.S. Sansom
榆林路捕房           1933年5月3日                书记员赵士周 (Chao Shih-chow)。

本人陆瑛，女，17岁，湖南人，住王家沙花园16号。我是江湾路文华（原文不清）中学的学生。
5月1日，我陪同姐姐 Lucie Loh 前往卡特路怡元里15号，在旁听他人谈话时被捕。

                                          (签名) 陆瑛。

HIGH COURT. A.M.

Proceedings:- Mr. K.S. Kum appeared for the Police.
            Mr. Tsai Chi Vung appeared for the Public Safety Bureau.
            Mr. Kum:- The Accused was arrested on May 1st. in
the International Settlement, suspected of being a communist.
Application was made by the Police for his detention. During
the remand period a Representative of the Public Safety Bureau
has identified the Accused as being a communist. This
Representative has brought the necessary witnesses to identify
him in open Court. The Police have no objections to the Accused
being handed over to the Chinese Authorities.
            Representative, Dan Oo Tsing:- Some of the witnesses
have surrendered to the P.S.B. and are in Court to identify the
Accused, and as they have not yet been released, I ask that the
case be heard in Camera.
            Court cleared by order of the Judge.
            Witness, Wong Ts Ping:- I am now a detective in the
Public Safety Bureau. I was a communist and surrendered myself to
the Authorities. I was arrested in last February. I was a member of
the French Concession Division. I identify Wong Seu Ching as being
a communist. He has an alias of Wong Peu Shak. He works for the
Ricksha Union in Chapei, and has taken a post in the Chapei Volunteers.
This was during the hostilities. I conversed with him when I was
also in the Volunteers.
            Accused, Wong Seu Ching:- I do not know this witness.
I had been in Shanghai only two days when I was arrested. I knew that
if I am a communist I would receive the death penalty if caught.
            Wong Pu Shak, 2nd. Accused in Yulin Road, No.5/36530
Case, was brought from the cells and placed in the dock with this
Accused, as the alias of this Accused was the same as the name of
the Yulin Road case 2nd. Accused. Witness identified this Accused
as being Wong Seu Ching, alias Wong PU Shak.

高等法院。上午。

诉讼过程:- K.S. Kum 先生代表警方出庭。
            Mr. Tsai Chi Vung 代表公共安全局出庭。
            Kum 先生:- 被告于5月1日在国际租界被捕，涉嫌为共产党员。
警方曾申请将其拘留。在延期审理期间，公共安全局的一名代表
已指认被告为共产党员。该
代表已携带必要证人到庭公开指认他。警方对将被告
移交给中国当局没有异议。
            代表 Dan Oo Tsing:- 部分证人已向公共安全局投案
并在庭上指认被告，由于他们尚未获释，我请求法庭
不公开审理此案。
            奉法官命令，法庭清场。
            证人 Wong Ts Ping:- 我目前是公共安全局的侦探。我曾是一名共产党员，后向当局投案。我于去年二月被捕。我是法租界分部成员。我指认 Wong Seu Ching 为共产党员。他有一个别名 Wong Peu Shak。他在闸北人力车工会工作，并在战事期间担任闸北义勇军的职务。当时我也在义勇军中，曾与他交谈过。
            被告 Wong Seu Ching:- 我不认识这位证人。我被捕时在上海仅待了两天。我知道如果我是共产党员，一旦被抓将被判处死刑。
            榆林路案件第5/36530号中的第二名被告 Wong Pu Shak 被从牢房带出，与本被告一同站在被告席上，因为本被告的别名与该案第二名被告的名字相同。证人指认本被告即为 Wong Seu Ching，别名 Wong PU Shak。

Wong Seu Ching (王秀清)
Meihsien, Kwangtung. D.S. Sansom
Singa Station 4-5-33 Clerk Liao Tsong Chien.

Wong Seu Ching, age 17, native of Meihsien (梅縣),
Kwangtung. At the age of 11, I commenced my education at a
primary school at Meihsien, remaining there for about 3½
years. Subsequently I studied at a middle school in Meihsien
and came to Shanghai about 3 years ago. On my arrival
here I studied at the Wen Fah (文法) College on Kwerming
Road for 2 weeks. The college then closed shortly afterwards.
I was arrested by the Chinese Authorities in off North
Szechuen Road for being a reactionary, and was imprisoned
for 1 year and 8 months. After being released from gaol
I returned to my native place. for one year.

On April 28, 1933 I returned to Shanghai and stayed
that night at the Dah Zung Lodging House on the corner of
Rue Chapsal and Rue Auguste Boppe, together with a friend
named Tsang Sueh (張水). On April 29 and 30 I stayed at
a lodging house somewhere on Rue du Consulat. I cannot
remember the exact whereabouts of this lodging house.

On May 1st I was standing on Wenchow Road when
the police arrested me.

(Signed) Wong Seu Ching.

Interrogator's Note
The address mentioned was visited and proved to
be false.

Wong Seu Ching (王秀清)
广东梅县。 警佐 Sansom
新闸捕房 1933年5月4日 书记员 Liao Tsong Chien。

Wong Seu Ching，17岁，广东梅县（梅縣）人。11岁时，我在梅县的一所小学开始受教育，在那里待了约3年半。随后我在梅县的一所中学读书，大约3年前来到上海。抵达此处后，我在昆山路文法（文法）学院学习了2周。该学院随后不久便关闭了。
我因被指为反动分子，在北四川路附近被中国当局逮捕，并被监禁1年8个月。出狱后，我回到家乡待了一年。

1933年4月28日，我返回上海，当晚与一位名叫 Tsang Sueh (張水) 的朋友住在 Chapsal 路与 Auguste Boppe 路转角的大中旅社。4月29日和30日，我住在领事馆路某处的一家旅社。我不记得那家旅社的确切位置。

5月1日，我正站在温州路上时被警察逮捕。

(签名) Wong Seu Ching。

审讯员注
所提及的地址经走访，证实为虚假。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. D 4901/33 Date May 20, 1933）

Subject (in full) Work of detectives and agents of S.I., Special Branch.

Made by D.S. Mac Adie Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

Since the organization of the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult, detectives and agents of the Special Branch forwarded reports on the formation of 4 branches and 6 section offices of the body and the details of 30 meetings held by the various branches. In addition they obtained some 57 different kinds of literature including posters, handbills, leaflets, cartoons, membership forms and documents relating to the internal organization of the body.

On May 1 the anniversary of International Labour Day, the liaison work of these men enabled Stations to intercept four different groups of demonstrators and arrest no less than 25 persons.

Of the detectives and agents of S.I., the following have been most hardworking and have kept the Special Branch informed of every move of the Branches in their respective districts:-

Made by and Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

With reference to attached report by D.S.MacAdie,
I recommend that the three agents mentioned be each given
a monetary award of $10.00. These men undoubtedly worked
hard in securing information regarding the activities of
this Association and were responsible for a good part of
the data contained in the reports submitted by D.S.MacAdie.
The Association concentrated for the most part on the
Eastern District where Special Branch enquiry work was
carried out under the supervision of D.D.S.156
Investigations were conducted in a tactful and
efficient manner and produced information which proved
valuable in deciding a police line of action in connexion
with the arrests on International Labour Day which
proved an effective check to the activities of the various
branches of the Association.
